source.title: Risk and Rizq
source.summary: How Islamic concepts of divine provision and chance gave the world the vocabulary of uncertainty, insurance, and entrepreneurship.
source.author: Islamic Economics
source.body_text: The word "hazard" comes from al-zahr, Arabic for dice. Explore how the Islamic concept of rizq (divine provision) created a culture of entrepreneurial risk-taking, how the prohibition of gharar (excessive uncertainty) shaped contract ethics, and how Khadijah bint Khuwaylid embodied the merchant spirit. From mudaraba partnerships to modern takaful insurance, now a $50 billion industry.
